instruction: The system sound is currently muted. Turn the audio back on by unmuting it.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep 'Mute:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}'

metadata.verification: Verified that pactl command 'pactl list sinks | grep Mute:' returns 'Mute: yes' or 'Mute: no'. When unmuted, awk extracts 'no\n'.
